source.title_on_document: Negotiating Creativity with AI: Effects on Self-Efficacy and Task-Performance

paper_design_summary: Short paper in the Proceedings of the 8th ACM Conference on Conversational User Interfaces (CUI 2026, pp. 1-6). Participants (N=28) did an ideation and ranking task while collaborating with an AI agent framed as a conversational teammate that challenged and defended its evaluations. The abstract reports creative self-efficacy and revision of initial idea rankings as outcomes, plus qualitative findings; it does not state the comparison condition or whether assignment was random.
